items.difficulty_reason: 16 行陈述含交换图（18 行证明）、特殊化映射与 DVR 扩张基变换交换：先验坐标合法性（引 section），scheme 理论像与基变换交换 + 循环基变换即闭包基变换，两头特殊化由模引理算出，末步闭纤维等同收。3 处引用全具名（含 statement 里的 More on Algebra definition），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-specialization-extension (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 475-490

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: First observe the generic and closed fibres of X' over R' identify with base changes of the fibres of X over R, making the vertical arrows meaningful; then for an integral closed subscheme Z of X_K with scheme theoretic image in X, the base change Z_{K'} is closed in X_{K'} with scheme theoretic image the base change of the closure, and both specialization maps are computed on the corresponding generator by the cited specialization-module lemma; the final identification of the closed fibres of the base-changed closure concludes the commutativity (source lines 492-509)
